title: 存在连续三个奇数的数组
summary: 判断数组中是否存在连续三个都是奇数的元素。
insight: 扫描维护当前连续奇数长度，遇偶数清零，达到三立即成功。
pitfalls: 负奇数也可用 value%2!=0 判断

solutions.title: 奇数连续段计数
solutions.idea: 在线跟踪当前奇数段长度。
steps: 奇数则 consecutive++，偶数则置零
consecutive==3 返回 true，结束 false

code.java: class Solution { public boolean threeConsecutiveOdds(int[] arr){int consecutive=0;for(int value:arr){consecutive=value%2!=0?consecutive+1:0;if(consecutive==3)return true;}return false;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun threeConsecutiveOdds(arr:IntArray):Boolean{var consecutive=0;for(value in arr){consecutive=if(value%2!=0)consecutive+1 else 0;if(consecutive==3)return true};return false} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool threeConsecutiveOdds(vector<int>& arr){int consecutive=0;for(int value:arr){consecutive=value%2?consecutive+1:0;if(consecutive==3)return true;}return false;} };
